responsibility: This option file declares the driver-only command-line switches specific to the m68k uClinux toolchain integration, notably elf2flt and elf2flt= along with static-libc. Its role is to expose the options used by the driver/linker-spec layer in uclinux.h for FLAT executable processing and libc selection, rather than to control backend instruction selection directly.
same_name_distinction: Declares the uClinux-specific driver options such as elf2flt, elf2flt=, and static-libc that are referenced by the uClinux subtarget integration. Unlike uclinux.h it does not set linker specs, builtins, default PIC mode, or relocation-policy macros; it only exposes the command-line switches for that environment.
